title: Captain Mira's Quiet Journey
moral: Staying calm and careful helps in every journey.

scenes.summary: Captain Mira plans a calm journey to a secret island.
scenes.text: Captain Mira sailed slowly with her crew, planning a quiet visit to a secret island.
scenes.image_prompt: calm pirate captain steering ship peaceful sea cartoon style
scenes.story: Captain Mira sailed with her crew to a quiet island. A fog came, but she stayed calm and guided everyone safely. They reached the island and found food in a hidden box. A soft rain came, but they stayed happy and safe. They returned home peacefully, proud of their calm and careful journey.
